camel_example: aliyun vod PreloadVodObjectCaches --region cn-hangzhou --ObjectPath 'vod.test.com/test.txt' --Area domestic --WithHeader 'Accept-Encoding_:_gzip,_deflate,_br' --L2Preload true
description_en: Prefetches content from the origin server to L2 Cache nodes so that the first access directly hits the cache, reducing the load on the origin server
description_zh: 调用本接口将源站的内容主动预热到L2 Cache节点上，首次访问可直接命中缓存，缓解源站压力
kebab_example: aliyun vod preload-vod-object-caches --object-path vod.test.com/test.txt --area domestic --l2-preload true --with-header Accept-Encoding_:_gzip,_deflate,_br --region cn-hangzhou
name: PreloadVodObjectCaches

parameters.description_zh: 预热文件URL。多个URL使用换行符（\n或\r\n）分隔。
parameters.help_zh: 预热文件URL。多个URL使用换行符（\n或\r\n）分隔
parameters.name: object_path

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to directly prefetch content to L2 nodes. Valid values:

- **true**: The prefetch node level must include L2 nodes.

- **false**: Only back-to-origin layer nodes are prefetched. This is the **default value**. The back-to-origin layer node may be an L2 node or an L3 node.
parameters.description_zh:
是否直接预热到L2节点。取值：

- **true**：代表预热的节点层级必须包含L2节点。

- **false**：代表仅预热回源层节点（false为**默认值**，回源层节点可能是L2节点，也可能是L3节点）。

parameters.description_en: The default header carried in a prefetch request is Accept-Encoding:gzip. If you want the prefetch request to carry other headers or implement multi-copy prefetch, use this parameter to customize prefetch headers. Submit the value in JSON format.
